Data & Insights.summary: Even though urea prices have dropped, higher import costs for DAP and MOP fertilizers have increased overall expenses. This price shift may cause the fertilizer subsidy to exceed the FY27 estimate and strain the national exchequer.

Data & Insights.title: India-US trade in focus? Commerce Ministry calls exporters for September 1 meeting: Report
Data & Insights.summary: India's Commerce Ministry has scheduled a meeting with exporters and industry groups on September 1. The purpose of the meeting is to assess trade and tariff concerns between India and the United States.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan seek to unlock next phase of $1.5 billion trade ties
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi visited Tashkent to discuss expanding economic relations between India and Uzbekistan. Both nations currently share $1.5 billion in bilateral trade and aim to double this figure to $3 billion within three years.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council sets date for first meeting since rationalisation last year
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council will hold its 57th meeting on September 12 in New Delhi. This gathering follows the council's first meeting since last year's tax rationalisation and will be preceded by an officers' meeting on September 11.

Data & Insights.title: India to start preparations for Budget 2027 from 12 October
Data & Insights.summary: India will begin preparations for the Union Budget 2027 starting October 12. Finance Secretary (Expenditure) V. Vualnam will chair the upcoming pre-budget meetings.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record high following Reserve Bank of India measures to attract US dollars. This increase provides the central bank with greater capacity to support the rupee, which continues to be one of Asia's weakest currencies.

India.title: Amid Alliance Suspense, Akali-BJP Student Wings Tie Up For University Polls
India.summary: The student wings of the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal announced an alliance on Sunday. The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad and the Students' Organisation of India formed this partnership for upcoming university elections.

India.title: Activist Manoj Jarange Sets Mumbai Protest Deadline, Devendra Fadnavis Reaches Out
India.summary: Maratha activist Manoj Jarange has given a deadline for a protest in Mumbai, demanding Kunbi caste certificates for eligible community members. In response to the ultimatum, Maharashtra leader Devendra Fadnavis has reached out to him.

India.title: Assam Clears Rs 50,000-Crore Package For Women, Health, Roads, Schools
India.summary: Assam has approved a Rs 50,000-crore investment package focused on women, health, roads, and schools. This includes an allocation of approximately Rs 700 crore to upgrade nearly 1,000 high schools throughout the state.

India.title: "Islam Superior," Says Karnataka Minister. BJP Demands Apology To Hindus
India.summary: BJP spokesperson Ashok Gowda accused the minister and the Congress government of trying to appease "his voters".

India.summary: A glacier collapse caused a massive flash flood in Nepal and Tibet on Wednesday, resulting in widespread damage. Rescue operations have recovered 734 bodies, with 275 Indian nationals among the nearly 2,500 people still missing.

India.title: Assam Government Approves Proton Beam Cancer Therapy Facility
India.summary: The Assam government has approved a new proton beam cancer therapy facility as part of a broader infrastructure development plan. This capital expenditure initiative also encompasses projects in healthcare, education, roads, power, housing, and industry.
